title: Nobel Prizes
tagline: Every Nobel Prize and laureate since 1901: who won, when, how old they were, where they were born and worked.
attribution: Data: Nobel Prize Outreach, api.nobelprize.org (CC0). Not endorsed by Nobel Prize Outreach.

countries.label: Countries
countries.description: Present-day countries (ISO alpha-3) used for birth, death and institution locations.

laureates.label: Laureates
laureates.description: People and organisations who received a Nobel Prize. One row each, even if they won twice.

prizes.label: Prizes
prizes.description: One row per category per year, including years when no prize was awarded (is_awarded = 0).

awards.label: Awards
awards.description: Who won which prize (laureate x prize). The main fact table: count rows to count prizes won.

affiliations.label: Institutions
affiliations.description: Universities and institutes laureates were affiliated with when they won.

award_affiliations.label: Award institutions
award_affiliations.description: Bridge: which institution(s) each award is credited to.

awards.label: Prizes won
awards.description: the default way to count Nobel prizes or wins here, one per laureate credited

caveats: Counting awards counts wins: Marie Curie, Bardeen, Sanger, Sharpless, the Red Cross (3x) and UNHCR (2x) appear more than once. Use COUNT(DISTINCT laureate_id) for people.
age_at_award, gender and birth_* are NULL for the 28 organisations; filter kind = 'person' for age or gender questions.
prizes includes 49 rows with is_awarded = 0 (wars, reserved years). Filter is_awarded = 1 when counting prizes.
Country = present-day country of birth (countryNow). birth_country_then keeps the historical name (Prussia, Russian Empire, Austria-Hungary).

tryPrompts.text: How many women have won a Nobel Prize?
tryPrompts.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS women_laureates FROM laureates WHERE gender = 'female'

tryPrompts.text: Which categories have the most prizes?
tryPrompts.sql: SELECT c.name AS category, COUNT(*) AS awards FROM awards a JOIN prizes p ON p.prize_id = a.prize_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY awards DESC

tryPrompts.text: Women and men laureates by decade
tryPrompts.sql: SELECT p.decade, l.gender, COUNT(*) AS laureates FROM awards a JOIN prizes p ON p.prize_id = a.prize_id JOIN laureates l ON l.laureate_id = a.laureate_id WHERE l.kind = 'person' GROUP BY p.decade, l.gender ORDER BY p.decade

tryPrompts.text: How old are laureates when they win?
tryPrompts.sql: SELECT (age_at_award / 5) * 5 AS age_band, COUNT(*) AS laureates FROM awards WHERE age_at_award IS NOT NULL GROUP BY age_band ORDER BY age_band

tryPrompts.text: Are laureates getting older? Age at award by year
tryPrompts.sql: SELECT p.award_year, a.age_at_award, c.name AS category, l.name AS laureate FROM awards a JOIN prizes p ON p.prize_id = a.prize_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN laureates l ON l.laureate_id = a.laureate_id WHERE a.age_at_award IS NOT NULL

tryPrompts.text: Which countries were the most laureates born in?
tryPrompts.sql: SELECT co.country_code, co.name AS country, COUNT(*) AS laureates FROM laureates l JOIN countries co ON co.country_code = l.birth_country_code GROUP BY co.country_code, co.name ORDER BY laureates DESC

SELECT l.name AS laureate, l.birth_city, l.birth_latitude AS latitude, l.birth_longitude AS longitude, p.award_year FROM awards a JOIN prizes p ON p.prize_id = a.prize_id JOIN laureates l ON l.laureate_id = a.laureate_id WHERE p.category_id = 'phy' AND l.birth_latitude IS NOT NULL

SELECT af.name AS institution, co.name AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.award_id) AS prizes FROM affiliations af JOIN award_affiliations aa ON aa.affiliation_id = af.affiliation_id LEFT JOIN countries co ON co.country_code = af.country_code GROUP BY af.affiliation_id ORDER BY prizes DESC LIMIT 10

morePrompts.text: Prize money over time, adjusted for inflation
morePrompts.sql: SELECT award_year, MAX(prize_amount_adj_sek) AS prize_amount_adj_sek FROM prizes GROUP BY award_year ORDER BY award_year

SELECT p.decade, c.name AS category, COUNT(*) AS awards FROM awards a JOIN prizes p ON p.prize_id = a.prize_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY p.decade, c.name ORDER BY p.decade

morePrompts.text: Average age at award per decade
morePrompts.sql: SELECT decade, ROUND(AVG(age_at_award), 1) AS avg_age FROM award_facts WHERE age_at_award IS NOT NULL GROUP BY decade ORDER BY decade
